name: TextAnimate
description: Text that animates in by character, word or line using a preset: fade in, blur in, slide up or scale up. The words are real text in the page from the start.

children.description: The text. In line mode, each new line (a newline character) is one unit.

by.description: What is animated one after another.

delay.description: Seconds before the first unit starts.

stagger.description: Seconds between one unit starting and the next.

whenInView.description: Waits until the text scrolls into view before playing.

isPaused.description: Stops the animation and shows the finished text. Moving content that lasts more than five seconds should be stoppable.

requirements: The full text is present as visually hidden text, so assistive technology reads it once and never character by character
The animated copy is hidden from assistive technology
With no JavaScript, or with reduced motion, the text is shown at once
Decoration only: the animated layers are hidden from assistive technology and never take focus
Stands still for visitors who ask for less motion (prefers-reduced-motion), and can also be shown still with the rdm-still class or isPaused
In forced-colors (high contrast) mode the text is drawn in the system colours
Does not flash: nothing changes more than three times in a second (WCAG 2.3.1)
Optional: it is a separate component, so projects that do not add it carry none of its code
screenReader: The full text is read once; the animation is not announced

use_when: A heading or short intro that should arrive with some life
Staggering a short list of words
anti_patterns: Animating by character on text that will be read aloud
A very long total time: delay plus stagger times the number of units should stay short
